headline: Cape Storm Rages On; Mooring Ledger Grows Heavier
war_summary: The Cape fight has not slackened. Callum's Cape, holding four Warden works against three Colonial, logged seven actions in the past two hours and, in a single hour, more than twelve hundred Colonial and fifteen hundred Warden casualties — the sharpest exchange on the map. Mooring County has become the heaviest ledger of the day: six actions inside two hours, the latest past eleven, while the day's rolls show some twelve thousand seven hundred Colonial and eleven thousand six hundred Warden dead; the Wardens there hold ten works against one Colonial and one unclaimed. The Nevish Line and Godcrofts, both aflame at the previous edition, have fallen silent, with no actions in two hours. Weathered Expanse still smoulders — seven Warden works, two unclaimed, nine Warden captures in the day and roughly thirty-five hundred casualties a side. Linn Mercy stands ten Colonial works and one unclaimed, quiet this watch. Marban Hollow's lines, four Warden to three Colonial and one unclaimed, have likewise gone still.
